mapper.select: INSERT INTO nw_user_profiles(id,tenant_id,end_user_id,summary,summaries,interaction_count,revision,last_session_at) VALUES(#{id},#{tenantId},#{endUserId},#{initialSummary}, #{entries,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.chat.persistence.ProfileSummariesTypeHandler},1,1,#{lastSessionAt}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,end_user_id) DO UPDATE SET summaries = (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(summary_window.entry ORDER BY summary_window.position), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(nw_user_profiles.summaries || EXCLUDED.summaries) WITH ORDINALITY AS summary_window(entry,position) WHERE summary_window.position > jsonb_array_length(nw_user_profiles.summaries || EXCLUDED.summaries) - #{max}), interaction_count = nw_user_profiles.interaction_count + 1, revision = nw_user_profiles.revision + 1, last_session_at = EXCLUDED.last_session_at, updated_at = now() RETURNING id,tenant_id,end_user_id,summary,summaries,interaction_count,revision,last_session_at
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_user_profiles SET summary=#{summary},revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND end_user_id=#{endUserId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_user_profiles (id, tenant_id, end_user_id, summary, structured_fields, preferences, interaction_count, revision, last_session_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{endUserId}, #{summary}, #{structuredFields,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.shared.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{preferences,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.shared.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{interactionDelta}, 1, #{lastSessionAt}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, end_user_id) DO UPDATE SET summary = EXCLUDED.summary, structured_fields = EXCLUDED.structured_fields, preferences = EXCLUDED.preferences, interaction_count = nw_user_profiles.interaction_count + EXCLUDED.interaction_count, revision = nw_user_profiles.revision + 1, last_session_at = EXCLUDED.last_session_at, updated_at = now()
